nooltech_feature_report.md.content:
# Nool Tech feature and functionality report

The browser review and shipped-code inspection identified **412 capability entries**, organized into **14 areas and 77 module sections**. The captured router defines **101 route patterns**. The evidence includes **144 JavaScript files**, **444 literal client API call sites**, and a separate record of browser screen and form observations.

Target: [app.nooltech.com](https://app.nooltech.com/). Inspection date: 31 October 2026.

## Open the inventory

| Artifact | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [Full feature catalog](feature_catalog.md) | Every capability, its behavior, role context, source anchor, and verification gap |
| [Feature spreadsheet](feature_inventory.csv) | Filterable inventory with 412 rows |
| [Feature JSON](feature_inventory.json) | The same inventory for subsequent analysis or implementation planning |
| [Browser observations](browser_observations.csv) | Screens and forms actually inspected, with links to retained observations |
| [Route reference](routes.csv) | Client route patterns and role contexts |
| [Client API call reference](client_api_calls.csv) | Literal method/path expressions and source locations |
| [Plan feature matrix](plan_feature_matrix.csv) | All 42 feature flags returned by the public plans endpoint |
| [REA evidence and limitations](rea_findings.md) | Analysis runs, Evidence IDs, coverage, and retained output |
| [Validation record](validation.json) | Source-anchor and artifact checks |

## What the evidence establishes

The signed-in business account displayed a trial with all features unlocked. Browser navigation covered the business modules, settings, public shop, booking calendar, and public sign-in pages. Forms and menus were opened without submitting business changes. The tailor order wizard was followed through review using an existing customer and measurement. Existing order details, an invoice, and the job sheet were inspected.

Each catalog entry remains **Code-defined** because its complete action was not executed. Related browser files establish that a screen, field, or control was visible. They do not prove successful creation, deletion, payment, refund, delivery, or external messaging. Counts describe documented entries, which sometimes group related actions. They are not counts of independently tested operations.

Customer sessions after OTP verification and platform administrator sessions were not available. Those capabilities were extracted from shipped client modules and service definitions. Server source, database schemas, background jobs, authorization enforcement, and mobile app internals were not inspected.

## Functional areas

| Area | Entries | Features and functionality |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| Dashboard | 7 | Revenue and order summaries, customer and overdue counts, recent activity, quick actions, usage, progress, and announcements |
| Identity and onboarding | 19 | Business email/password and Google sign-in, remembered session option, password reset request, verification email resend, two-factor flow, signup, business setup, referral/promo validation, staff activation, and tours |
| Customer management | 26 | Customer creation and editing, search and segmentation, tags and fit preferences, address/contact details, avatars, activity and order history, customer links, inactivity recovery, and bulk communication preparation |
| Measurements and garment masters | 16 | Garment-specific dimensions, member/profile labels under a contact, custom fields, inch/cm units, version history, reference photos, timeline charts, and configurable garment masters |
| Tailor orders and delivery | 42 | Four-step order entry, multiple garment items, measurement linkage, delivery dates, discounts and advance, priority, status updates, item editing, repeat/clone, attachments, worker assignments, per-item delivery, and change history |
| Production and workforce | 23 | Seven-stage production board, search/sort and bulk movement, assignments, worker directory, per-item visual job sheets, construction notes and component lists, worker payments, and payroll summaries |
| Boutique catalog and POS | 35 | Product categories, SKU/barcode, images, sizes, HSN/GST, prices and stock, quantity discounts, CSV import/export, stock receipt, three-step checkout, cash/UPI/card/split/credit, held carts, loyalty, returns, and exchanges |
| Inventory and purchasing | 46 | Material stock register, reorder thresholds, auto-PO configuration, fabric rolls, variants, serialized/bundle flags, reservations, stock adjustments, transfers, reconciliation, scans and labels, accounting exports, vendor records, purchase orders, receiving, and supplier reports |
| Finance and reporting | 34 | Invoices, payment histories and receipts, balance due, expenses and categories, day reports, revenue/profit views, forecasting and customer insights, custom report definitions, filtering/grouping/sorting, charts, and exports |
| Workspace and security | 22 | Business profile, specialization, invoice branding and GST, language/theme, team invitations and permissions, shop page settings, locations, audit logs, notifications, automatic WhatsApp opt-in, privacy consent, data exports, nominee, and deletion requests |
| Plans, billing, and support | 9 | Subscription selection, plan limits and feature gates, Razorpay checkout definitions, auto-renewal, invoice history, referrals/credits, support tickets, user guide, and FAQs |
| Customer portal and public pages | 45 | Customer Google/phone/email authentication, linked-shop portal, dashboard/orders/appointments/measurements/invoices/profile, public booking, shop showcase and order tracking, Fit Card sharing/import, and app links |
| Engagement and tailoring tools | 18 | Shop levels, activity progress, first-orders challenge/reward, daily reminder list, bra-to-blouse estimate, waist estimate, garment-to-body estimate, fabric estimate, size charts, conversions, and tailoring tips |
| Platform administration | 70 | Tenant and subscription administration, plan management, platform billing/reports/audit, announcements, support and WhatsApp inbox, feature flags, bulk actions, system settings, referrals/promos, admin roles, tenant health, alerts, retention, templates, trials, and blog management |

The detailed action list and source evidence are in the [full catalog](feature_catalog.md). The 70 platform entries describe the software operator's administration interface, separate from a shop administrator's interface.

## Main workflows

### Tailor order

```text
Customer → measurements → garments, quantities, prices and date → review
                                                                  ↓
                         order details ← create order definition
                               ↓
                production / delivery / invoice / payments
```

The four wizard steps were visible. Item selection requires a garment and, for garments with measurement fields, an explicitly linked measurement. The measurements step allows proceeding without adding measurements. A price can remain zero for pricing at delivery. Review exposes fixed or percentage discount, advance, and normal/urgent priority. Creation was not submitted. [Wizard evidence](evidence/screens/tailor-wizard-review.json)

Order status and production stage are separate fields. The status choices are `pending`, `in-progress`, `completed`, `delivered`, and `cancelled`. The production stages are `new`, `measuring`, `cutting`, `stitching`, `quality_check`, `ready_for_pickup`, and `completed`. Their complete server transition rules remain unknown. [Order editor](evidence/screens/order-edit.json), [production board](evidence/screens/production.json)

Delivery definitions support quantities by item. Order detail also defines repeat orders, cancellation, worker assignment, attachments, payment recording, and change history. The job sheet has visual configuration, construction notes, a component checklist, measurements, print, and save controls. [Job sheet](evidence/screens/job-sheet.json)

### Boutique sale

```text
Customer → product cart → payment → sale / receipt definition
                ↕                         ↓
            held carts             return or exchange definitions
```

The initial POS screen was inspected. Catalog products were empty in this account, so a populated checkout was not exercised. Shipped code defines quantity tiers, discounts, GST, optional stitching charges, loyalty redemption, cash/UPI/card/split/credit payments, and receipt composition. Returns and exchanges have distinct client paths. [POS screen](evidence/screens/new-sale.json), [core findings](core_findings.md)

### Materials and procurement

```text
Item + reorder settings → draft purchase order → approval / ordering
                                                   ↓
                                    partial or full receipt → stock

Physical count → compare system quantities → review → post adjustments
```

Purchase-order status choices are `Draft`, `Approved`, `Ordered`, `PartiallyReceived`, `Received`, and `Cancelled`. Stock transfers use `in_transit`, `completed`, and `cancelled`. The reconciliation start screen explains that a new count snapshots system stock. No count, transfer, or purchase order was created. [PO screen](evidence/screens/purchase-orders.json), [reconciliation screen](evidence/screens/stock-reconciliation.json)

### Customer access

```text
Public shop → book a visit / track order / request app connection
Customer sign-in → linked shops → orders, measurements, invoices and appointments
```

The public shop offers tracking using order number plus phone number. Global customer sign-in offers Google, phone OTP, and email OTP. The authenticated customer portal is code-defined; OTP requests and customer login were not performed. Fit Card and invitation routes use tokens, whose issuance and complete server validation were not tested. [Public shop](evidence/screens/public-shop.json), [customer sign-in](evidence/screens/public-customer-login.json)

## Data and permissions reference

The following is an inferred client data model, not a recovered database schema.

| Record | Fields and relationships found in the client |
| --- | --- |
| Shop/workspace | Business type and specialization, profile, address, branding, GST, plan, limits, feature flags, locations |
| Business user | Profile, role, onboarding/tour state, team access, security and two-factor settings |
| Customer | Contact details, customer type, address, tags, fit/fabric preferences, avatar, orders, measurement profiles, loyalty |
| Measurement | Customer, garment type, member/profile label, dimensions map, custom dimensions, unit, notes, version, reference photos |
| Order/item | Customer, garment, quantity, price, measurement link, dates, priority, discount, advance, status, production stage, delivered quantity |
| Job sheet | Item identity, visual garment type, design configuration, technical notes, components, measurement snapshot/update |
| Payment/refund | Order/customer relationship, amount, method, reference, notes, type, attachments |
| Product | Category, SKU, brand, selling/cost price, stock, sizes, HSN, GST, quantity tiers, image |
| Inventory | SKU, category/unit, stock/reserved/available, costs, reorder settings, supplier, fabric attributes, variant/bundle/serial configuration, transactions |
| Vendor/PO | Vendor contacts, payment terms, documents and bank details; PO items, linked stock items, statuses, receipt and payment records |
| Worker/payroll | Role/contact details, assignments, assignment status, salary/advance/piece/deduction payment records |
| Report | Data source, selected columns, filters, grouping, sort, and chart type |
| Customer link/Fit Card | Global customer identity, linked shop/customer record, invitations, sharing token, imported measurements |
| Platform records | Tenants, plans/subscriptions, support, billing, announcements, alerts, retention policy, templates, trials, and blog content |

Business role controls include shop administrator, manager, and staff. Worker roles such as tailor, master cutter, stitching, and quality check describe production workers. They are separate from business login roles. The platform router requires `platform_admin`; that client guard does not establish server authorization. [Team form](evidence/screens/invite-team-dialog.json), [worker form](evidence/screens/new-worker-dialog.json)

## Current plan definitions

These are configuration values read from the [public plans endpoint](https://api.nooltech.com/api/plans) on the inspection date. They describe advertised configuration, rather than a test of entitlement enforcement. The inspected account was in a trial.

| Configured limit | Basic | Pro | Enterprise |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Monthly price | ₹249 | ₹699 | ₹1,399 |
| Yearly price | ₹2,690 | ₹7,550 | ₹15,110 |
| Customers | 300 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Orders | 150 | Unlimited | Unlimited |
| Users | 1 | 3 | 10 |
| Inventory items | 100 | 2,000 | Unlimited |
| Vendors | 0 | 100 | Unlimited |
| Purchase orders | 0 | 1,000 | Unlimited |
| Reports | 0 | 50 | Unlimited |
| SMS per month | 100 | 500 | 2,000 |
| Storage | 0.5 GB | 5 GB | 50 GB |

Basic has core CRM/orders, measurements, repeat orders, delivery calendar, balance due, standard invoices, product catalog, basic expenses/inventory, and thermal printing flags. Pro adds production/Kanban, worker management, full inventory, vendors/POs, advanced reports/analytics, reminders, and manager/multiple-staff controls. Enterprise adds multi-location, audit logs, workload/worker analytics, recovery campaigns, custom branding, API-access entitlement, and priority support. The complete comparison is in the [42-flag matrix](plan_feature_matrix.csv).

The API-access flag and marketing references to integrations or AI do not establish an implemented public developer API or a particular AI model. Older Plus/Plus+ and USD labels remain in some client copy. The captured server plan definitions are the reference used for this table.

## Gaps and incomplete behavior

| Finding | Evidence and scope |
| --- | --- |
| Booking slots fail for the tested shop/date | The calendar loaded, but the UI displayed a route-not-found error for its available-slots request on 31 October 2026. Appointment completion remains unverified. [Observation](evidence/screens/public-booking.json) |
| Missing measurement dimensions appear as zero in the profile chart | The default Chest chart showed zero while a blouse detail contained a bust value. Code uses a fixed field list and defaults missing dimensions to zero, without a bust-to-chest mapping. Mixed-unit comparison is also unverified. [Chart](evidence/screens/customer-measurements.json), [measurement detail](evidence/screens/measurement-detail.json), [code analysis](core_findings.md) |
| Password-save branch has no update request | The inspected settings branch validates matching new passwords, clears fields, and reports success without a password-change API call. This is a static finding. The current social-login account did not expose that password form. [Back-office findings](backoffice_findings.md) |
| Held-cart resume omits customer restoration | The save object includes the customer, while the inspected resume routine restores cart/payment details without setting the selected customer. Runtime impact was not tested. [Core findings](core_findings.md) |
| Refund and stock restoration are separate | The client records a refund and then attempts stock restoration in a separate request whose errors are discarded. Exchange navigation alone does not establish stock restoration. No return/refund was submitted. [Core findings](core_findings.md) |
| Reminder Sent state does not confirm delivery | Reminder actions open an external WhatsApp composer and mark a browser-local Sent state on click. Delivery was not tested. [Portal findings](portal_platform_findings.md) |
| Some configuration is local to the browser | Held carts, drafts, unit selection, some loyalty settings, dismissed announcements, and label counters use localStorage. Cross-device synchronization is not established for those values. [Core findings](core_findings.md), [back-office findings](backoffice_findings.md) |

## Completeness boundary

This is the extracted inventory for the supplied application and inspected build. It covers discoverable shipped client modules and the recorded UI states. It is not proof that every server capability, conditional integration, historical module, mobile screen, or role-restricted operation has been discovered.

The source anchors of all 412 entries were checked against retained files. Browser observations, plan configuration, routes, static API definitions, and REA results remain separate evidence sources. Full implementation planning can use the catalog while retaining these verification gaps.

core_findings.md.content:
# Core tailoring and boutique feature findings

These findings describe shipped client JavaScript captured from app.nooltech.com on 2026-10-31. They establish client controls, payload construction, and API call definitions. They do not establish server persistence or external message delivery. The parent investigator separately records browser observations and REA Evidence.

The structured inventory is [core_features.json](core_features.json). It contains 140 feature candidates. Every candidate has a source filename, an exact literal anchor, a character offset, a UTF-8 byte offset, and a verification gap. The offsets address the retained captured file, including its original minification.

## Main workflows

| Workflow | Client-defined sequence |
| --- | --- |
| Tailor booking | Select customer → review/create measurements → add garments, quantity, price, delivery date → review discount, advance, priority → create order |
| Production | New → measuring → cutting → stitching → quality check → ready for pickup → completed |
| Fulfilment | Select delivered quantities → add them to cumulative deliveredQty → submit per-item delivery record |
| Repeat | Select original items and quantities → optional delivery date and notes → repeat endpoint → new order |
| Alteration return | Reopen order to in-progress → optional new delivery date → save |
| Boutique sale | Select/create customer → catalog/cart → discount, GST, optional stitching and loyalty → cash, UPI, card, split, or credit → create completed/in-progress order |
| Boutique return | Select quantities → calculate original line-price refund → record cash refund → attempt product stock restoration |
| Boutique exchange | Select returned quantities → calculate credit → open a new sale with customer and credit in navigation state |
| Job sheet | Load by order and item → edit garment design, notes, component list, and dimensions → save per-item job sheet |

The client carries order status separately from productionStage. The seven-stage board is an advanced feature, while simple status tracking is a separate capability. No one-to-one backend transition table was available.

## Field and state reference

| Entity | Captured client fields and choices |
| --- | --- |
| Customer | First name, last name, phone, email, street/city/state/pincode, Regular/New/Important/Bulk type, tags, Slim/Regular/Relaxed fit, fabric notes, avatar |
| Measurement | Customer ID, garmentType, label/member name, dimensions map, custom dimensions, unit, notes, version/history, reference photos |
| Measurement units | inches, cm. Selection is saved in localStorage. |
| Tailor item | garmentType, custom name when applicable, quantity, pricePerItem, measurementId |
| Tailor order | customerId, items, priority, discountType, discountValue, advanceAmount, notes, deliveryDate, optional locationId |
| Order status | pending, in-progress, completed, delivered, cancelled |
| Production stage | new, measuring, cutting, stitching, quality_check, ready_for_pickup, completed |
| Assignment status | assigned, in-progress, completed |
| Product | Name, category, SKU, selling price, optional cost, stock, unit, brand, sizes, HSN, GST rate, low-stock threshold, description, discount tiers, image |
| Product status | active, out_of_stock, archived in client filtering and service behavior |
| Product categories | Tops, Sarees, Bottoms, Accessories, Dresses, Lehengas, Suits, Other |
| POS metadata | paymentMode, splitDetails, loyaltyPointsEarned, loyaltyPointsRedeemed, alterationCharge, bulkDiscountAmount, staffName |
| POS payment choices | cash, upi, card, split, credit |
| Order payment types | advance, partial, final, refund labels are rendered in the order-detail payment history |
| Job sheet | garmentType, designConfig, technicalNotes, components, measurementsSnapshot, changed measurementsUpdate |

## Limits and calculations found in code

- Order entry requires a customer. Garment items need a garment type, and a linked measurement when the garment master declares fields. The measurements step itself allows proceeding without records.
- Order-item editing requires at least one item, quantity at least one, and price at least zero.
- A tailor-order total of at least ₹100,000 opens a second amount confirmation.
- Draft recovery applies only to matching-customer measurement drafts younger than 24 hours. This is local form recovery, not an offline server synchronization system.
- Product creation requires a nonempty name, selling price greater than zero, and stock at least zero. Missing SKU gets a three-letter category prefix and a random three-digit suffix. Uniqueness enforcement is not established by this client routine.
- Profile measurement detail refuses more than five reference photos. Order detail refuses more than three attachments per displayed payment. Image/PDF file hints mention 3 MB; actual server limits were not exercised.
- Quantity discounts choose the highest matching minQty tier and round the discounted unit price.
- POS cash uses `Math.min(amountReceived || saleTotal, saleTotal)` as the advance. Blank or zero cash input therefore submits full payment. UPI and card also submit full payment. Credit submits zero. Split submits the sum of the three method inputs.
- POS loyalty redemption uses whole blocks of 100 available points and caps the discount at the sale amount. The payload carries point counts, while backend award/redemption behavior remains untested.
- A delivered order requires a positive final amount in the edit form. A user with `changePrices === false` cannot supply a changed final total in that payload.

## Confirmed client limitations

### Missing chart dimensions appear as zero

CustomerProfilePage-DWeCcTMZ.js defaults the chart field to `chest` and maps values through `p.measurements && p.measurements[c] || 0`. Its fixed dropdown includes chest, waist, hip, shoulder, sleeves, neck, length, and inseam. It contains no `bust` option or bust-to-chest mapping.

A blouse record with a bust value can therefore contribute zero to the default Chest chart. The parent investigator's zero Chest summary is consistent with this code, and does not establish that the customer's physical measurement is zero. The chart input also omits unit, so comparing records with different units has no conversion step here.

Anchors: `selectedField:c="chest"`, `[V,C]=x.useState("chest")`, and `p.measurements&&p.measurements[c]||0` in the captured profile module.

### Held cart resume omits selected customer restoration

CreateSalePage-Cj1oN_dA.js saves customerId and customerName with held cart data. Holding clears selected customer. The `ys` resume function restores cart, discount, GST, notes, and payment mode, removes the held record, and sets step 2. It does not call the selected-customer setter. Submission starts with `if(!a||!S.length)return`.

Resuming a held cart after its customer was cleared may leave confirmation blocked. This is a static control-flow concern; the parent did not create or hold a real sale to test it.

### Refund and inventory restoration are separate operations

OrderDetailPage-B2ZYKSVH.js records a cash refund, then calls restoreStock inside a nested try/catch whose errors are discarded. A successful refund therefore does not prove stock restoration succeeded. The selected return amount uses the line price and original quantity, without client reconciliation of tax, order discount, previous returns, or amount already refunded.

The exchange click handler passes credit into a new POS sale and does not call restoreStock itself. Backend return/exchange protection remains unknown.

### Several settings and drafts are browser-local

Held carts, measurement draft/unit, dismissed announcements, and catalog loyalty programme settings use localStorage. The client reads customer points from the API, but that does not establish that programme configuration syncs to other browsers.

### Communication buttons compose external messages

Order update SMS uses an `sms:` URL. WhatsApp actions open wa.me with encoded text. Bulk customer messaging opens message links and subsequently logs the prepared messages through a service. None of these client actions alone establishes that the recipient received the message.

### Status copies and payment constraints differ

The cancel modal's translated prompt describes a reason as optional, while its click handler requires a trimmed nonempty cancellation reason. A translated `amountCannotExceedBalance` string exists, but the inspected record-payment handler itself checks only that the amount is a positive number. Any upper limit belongs to server validation or another path and remains unverified.

## Core client API definitions

| Area | Defined method/path patterns |
| --- | --- |
| Customers | GET/POST `/api/customers`, GET/PATCH/DELETE `/api/customers/:id`, POST/DELETE `/api/customers/:id/avatar` |
| Measurements | POST `/api/measurements`, GET `/api/measurements/customer/:id`, PUT/DELETE `/api/measurements/:id`, POST `/api/measurements/:id/photos`, DELETE `/api/measurements/:id/photos/:photoId` |
| Customer app connection | POST `/api/customer-links/invites`, GET `/api/customer-links/customers/:id`, POST `/api/customer-links/customers/:id/disconnect` |
| Orders | GET/POST `/api/orders`, GET/PUT/DELETE `/api/orders/:id`, GET/POST `/api/orders/:id/repeat`, GET `/api/orders/customer/:id/repeat` |
| Delivery | GET `/api/orders/calendar`, GET `/api/orders/delivery-stats`, POST `/api/orders/:id/delivery` |
| Production | PATCH `/api/orders/:id/stage`, GET `/api/orders/kanban`, POST `/api/orders/kanban/bulk-update`, POST `/api/orders/:id/assignments`, DELETE `/api/orders/:id/assignments/:assignmentId` |
| Item and attachment editing | PATCH `/api/orders/:id/items`, POST `/api/orders/:id/attachments`, DELETE `/api/orders/:id/attachments/:attachmentId` |
| Invoices | GET `/api/invoices/order/:orderId`, POST `/api/invoices/:orderId/generate`, GET `/api/invoices/:invoiceId/download`, POST `/api/invoices/:invoiceId/resend` |
| Job sheets | GET/PUT `/api/job-sheets/:orderId/items/:itemId` |
| Products | GET/POST `/api/boutique/products`, GET/PUT/DELETE `/api/boutique/products/:id`, POST `/api/boutique/products/restore-stock`, GET `/api/boutique/products/export/csv`, POST `/api/boutique/products/import/csv`, POST/DELETE `/api/boutique/products/:id/image` |
| Loyalty | GET `/api/customers/:id/loyalty` |
| Dashboard | GET `/api/dashboard/summary`, GET `/api/dashboard/payments-summary`, GET `/api/users/team/summary` |

These paths are static client API definitions. Parameter placeholders summarize template strings and are not a recovered server schema. Successful invocation, required fields, server authorization, idempotency, and database transactions remain unverified.

## Evidence validation

`build_core_inventory.py` verifies each candidate anchor exists and records its exact source location. The generated JSON is parseable and all 140 source references were rechecked. Source-key and byte-offset verification is in the final investigator validation, with browser observations supplied independently by the parent.

backoffice_findings.md.content:
# Back-office feature findings

This code review records 113 meaningful feature groups across 26 modules. It uses the shipped browser JavaScript captured on 2026-10-31. Every row is Code-defined. The root investigator's browser observations can independently raise specific rows to UI-verified.

## Material limits

- Client definitions establish interfaces and intended behavior. They do not prove completed backend operations, authorization, delivery, financial settlement, compliance, or performance.
- Settings password save reports success after client validation but has no password-update request in that inspected branch. Password-change persistence is unverified and may be incomplete.
- Current feature flags come from /api/features/status. Legacy Plus/Plus+ labels coexist with basic/pro/enterprise. Report the live configuration when describing commercial availability.
- Day-report gross profit looks up cached costs in localStorage boutique_products_v1. This is an estimate, with missing costs possible.
- Serialized tracking configuration and label serial counters are distinct. Label counters alone do not establish inventory serial-number uniqueness.

## Feature reference

### Inventory

- **Inventory register and filters.** Search by name or SKU; filter category, active/out_of_stock/discontinued status, location, and low-stock flag. Paginated register shows item, SKU, category, stock, cost, status, and actions. Client requests 20 items per page. Source: [InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js](evidence/assets/InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js), literal `limit:20` at character 37916.
- **Inventory summary.** Summary cards show item count, in-stock items, stock value using cost times quantity, low-stock items, and out-of-stock items. Summary requests can be scoped to a location. Source: [InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js](evidence/assets/InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js), literal `inventory.costQty` at character 43639.
- **Create and edit inventory items.** SKU, name, description, category, unit, current stock, reorder level, reorder quantity, cost price, optional selling price, preferred vendor, brand, color, material, storage location, notes, and barcode. Categories are fabric/thread/button/zipper/accessory/lining/interlining/other. Units are meter/yard/piece/spool/kg/gram/dozen/pair. Source: [InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js](evidence/assets/InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js), literal `preferredVendorName` at character 3077.
- **Inventory item images.** Upload item image for an existing item; an authenticated image URL is used for previews. The service also defines image deletion. Source: [InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js](evidence/assets/InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js), literal `uploadImage` at character 5094.
- **Fabric roll attributes.** Fabric-only fields include width, width unit, roll flag, roll number, and remaining meters. Non-fabric saves omit fabricAttributes. Source: [InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js](evidence/assets/InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js), literal `fabricAttributes` at character 3162.
- **Automatic purchase-order configuration.** An item can enable autoPurchaseOrder and choose a separate autoPoVendorId or its preferred vendor. Reorder level and reorder quantity are supplied to the save request. Source: [InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js](evidence/assets/InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js), literal `autoPurchaseOrder` at character 3248.
- **Serialized stock flag.** Item configuration exposes isSerialTracked with a serialized-tracking explanation. Source: [InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js](evidence/assets/InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js), literal `isSerialTracked` at character 3287.
- **Inventory bundle definition.** Define isBundle and bundleComponents with component inventoryItemId and quantity. The form searches component items and explains component consumption. Source: [InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js](evidence/assets/InventoryFormPage-CApyL_Vg.js), literal `bundleComponents` at character 3318.
- **Consume an inventory bundle.** A client service defines POST /api/inventory/bundles/:id/consume with quantity, orderId, and orderNumber, and POST /api/inventory/bundles for creation. Source: [inventory.service-COh38tHV.js](evidence/dependencies/inventory.service-COh38tHV.js), literal `consumeBundle` at character 4301.
- **Size and color variants.** Expand an item's variants, inspect each variant's stock/reserved/available state, and create a variant with SKU, name, size, color, opening stock, and cost. Size/color compose variantAttributes. Name and SKU are required by the client. Source: [InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js](evidence/assets/InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js), literal `createVariant` at character 14615.
- **Stock adjustment and transaction history.** Add or remove stock with quantity, reason, and optional notes. Addition reasons include purchase/return/adjustment; removal includes sale/waste/adjustment. History displays transaction type, previous/new stock, actor, date, and notes. Source: [InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js](evidence/assets/InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js), literal `adjustStock` at character 42680.
- **Reserved and available stock.** Item detail shows currentStock, reservedStock, and availableStock. Services reserve stock for an order and release reservations by order ID. Source: [inventory.service-COh38tHV.js](evidence/dependencies/inventory.service-COh38tHV.js), literal `reserveStock` at character 2930.
- **Demand forecast and reorder suggestion.** Item detail requests a 30-day demand forecast and displays average daily sales, suggested reorder, days until stockout, and actual/forecast chart series. Source: [InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js](evidence/assets/InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js), literal `getDemandForecast` at character 21710.
- **Dispatch inter-branch stock transfer.** Select source and destination branch, positive integer quantity no greater than current stock, and notes. The service receives itemId, quantity, fromLocationId, toLocationId, and notes. Different locations are required by client validation. Source: [InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js](evidence/assets/InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js), literal `initiateTransfer` at character 1568.
- **Receive or cancel stock transfer.** Incoming transfer panel has in-transit and history tabs, refresh, mark-as-received, and cancellation with a reason. UI copy says cancellation returns stock to source. States shown are in_transit/completed/cancelled. Source: [InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js](evidence/assets/InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js), literal `receiveTransfer` at character 28299.
- **Inventory CSV import and export.** Download full inventory CSV or a template; upload .csv, preview the first five detected rows, then import and show created/updated counts plus row errors. Export columns include SKU, Name, Description, Category, Unit, CurrentStock, ReorderLevel, CostPrice, SellingPrice, IsActive, CreatedAt, and UpdatedAt. Source: [InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js](evidence/assets/InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js), literal `inventory-template.csv` at character 2340.
- **Accounting software exports.** Export inventory in Tally XML, QuickBooks IIF, or Zoho CSV format through /api/inventory/export/accounting?format=... . Source: [InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js](evidence/assets/InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js), literal `QuickBooks IIF` at character 1225.
- **Camera and hardware barcode lookup.** Look up stock from camera scans or keyboard input from USB/Bluetooth scanners. UI mentions Code128 and QR support. It handles denied camera permission, camera error, item-found state, view item, scan another item, and quick receive quantity. Source: [InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js](evidence/assets/InventoryListPage-CHPeDHmS.js), literal `USB / Bluetooth scanner?` at character 26693.
- **Item QR download and label print.** Generate an item QR code, download its image, and print a product label from item detail. Source: [InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js](evidence/assets/InventoryItemPage-DMAMvDYp.js), literal `inventoryItem.downloadQR` at character 35522.
- **Inventory item deletion service.** The inventory service defines DELETE /api/inventory/:id. Source: [inventory.service-COh38tHV.js](evidence/dependencies/inventory.service-COh38tHV.js), literal `async delete(a)` at character 985.

### Stock reconciliation

- **Opt in and monitor automated WhatsApp.** Read enabled state, usage used/limit/resetDate, and trial/plan information. Enabling opens explicit consent confirmation; disabling calls save immediately. Update is through workspace auto-whatsapp API. Source: [SettingsPage-BspbE0gu.js](evidence/assets/SettingsPage-BspbE0gu.js), literal `auto-whatsapp-toggle` at character 89242.

### Subscription

- **Plan selection and usage limits.** Free/basic/pro/enterprise plans, trial days, usage progress, limit warnings at 80% and full limits, upgrade prompts, and prevention of downgrades where current usage exceeds proposed limits. Legacy plus aliases/copy also exist. Source: [SettingsPage-BspbE0gu.js](evidence/assets/SettingsPage-BspbE0gu.js), literal `usageExceedsLimits` at character 155611.
- **Razorpay upgrade and renewal checkout.** Monthly/yearly billing, mid-cycle unused-time credit, amount due, included features, payment order/subscription verification, success state, and optional Razorpay auto-renewal. UI supports reminder-based manual renewal as an alternative. Source: [SettingsPage-BspbE0gu.js](evidence/assets/SettingsPage-BspbE0gu.js), literal `Mid-cycle Upgrade Credit` at character 10678.

### Billing

- **Subscription billing and invoice history.** Read current subscription, plan, status, next billing, failed payment attempts, grace-period warning, and invoice history. Invoice amount is formatted from minor units; download action opens /api/billing/invoices/:id/download in a new tab. Source: [BillingPage-yg0BBQBP.js](evidence/assets/BillingPage-yg0BBQBP.js), literal `/api/billing/invoices` at character 924.
- **Referral program.** Fetch referral code and link, copy signup link, show referral count/earned/used/available credits and recent referrals, and apply a code within server-specified signup window for a first-subscription discount. Source: [BillingPage-yg0BBQBP.js](evidence/assets/BillingPage-yg0BBQBP.js), literal `/api/referral/apply-code` at character 1462.

### Support

- **User guide and FAQs.** Built-in guides cover dashboard, orders/job tickets, customers/measurements, workers, inventory, billing, and settings. English, Tamil, and Kannada guide text is bundled. Source: [HelpSupportPage-hwN8-IWU.js](evidence/assets/HelpSupportPage-hwN8-IWU.js), literal `The Dashboard` at character 834.
- **Submit and track support tickets.** Create category billing/technical/feature_request/account/other, subject, description, and low/medium/high/urgent priority. List own tickets; states include open/in_progress/waiting_on_customer/resolved/closed. Detail shows author/replies/resolution and permits replies. Source: [HelpSupportPage-hwN8-IWU.js](evidence/assets/HelpSupportPage-hwN8-IWU.js), literal `submitTicket` at character 450.

### Notifications

- **Notification center.** List all/unread notifications, display type order/payment/inventory/worker/customer, mark one read, mark all read, delete, and navigate through an attached action URL when present. Source: [NotificationsPage-o81_zfqQ.js](evidence/assets/NotificationsPage-o81_zfqQ.js), literal `markAllAsRead` at character 847.

### Access and entitlements

- **Business-type and plan gates.** Tailor features depend on tailor/both mode; inventory/vendors/purchase orders on boutique/both. Runtime feature status is fetched. Static mapping places worker/vendor/purchasing/inventory/advanced reporting/analytics on pro and workload/worker analytics/multi-location/custom branding/audit logs on enterprise. Source: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js), literal `workerManagement:"pro"` at character 204074.

## Field and state highlights

| Area | Values recovered |
| --- | --- |
| Purchase-order state | Draft, Approved, Ordered, PartiallyReceived, Received, Cancelled |
| Purchase payment state | Pending, Paid |
| Stock transfer | in_transit, completed, cancelled |
| Stock transaction | purchase, sale, adjustment, return, waste, transfer |
| Reconciliation | draft, posted |
| Inventory status | active, out_of_stock, discontinued |
| Worker assignment | assigned, in-progress, completed |
| Salary mode | monthly, daily, piece_rate |
| Payroll payment | salary, advance, piece_payment, deduction |
| Vendor status | Active, Inactive |
| Vendor terms | Net 30, Net 60, Net 90, Advance, COD, Custom |
| Report source | orders, customers, payments, inventory, vendors |
| Report filter | eq, ne, gt, gte, lt, lte, contains, startsWith, endsWith |
| Report aggregation | sum, avg, min, max, count |
| Report chart | none, bar, line, pie, area |
| Business mode | tailor, boutique, both |
| Garment classification | male, female, unisex, service |
| Theme | light, dark, system |
| Support ticket | open, in_progress, waiting_on_customer, resolved, closed |

## Provenance

JSON rows preserve exact source path, literal anchor, character offset, role qualification, and verification gap. Character offsets refer to decoded UTF-8 text and are not byte offsets. All anchors were checked against the retained files during generation.

## Static client API call appendix

The machine-readable [API call appendix](backoffice_api_calls.json) records 170 literal HTTP call sites across selected back-office services and embedded settings services. These are client request definitions, not observed requests, complete schemas, or proof that all handlers are deployed. Dynamic expressions are retained as written.

# Portal, public, identity, engagement, and platform findings

This code review records 159 capabilities in 35 modules. All entries are code-defined. The root investigator owns browser verification and REA output. These findings do not claim successful writes, message delivery, billing settlement, access enforcement, or completeness of server behavior.

## Scope and limits

- Sources are the exact shipped minified client files captured from app.nooltech.com, including non-vendor dependencies.
- Customer portal identity is separate from business identity. Global customer routes can aggregate linked shops.
- /platform routes require platform_admin in the shipped router. A shop administrator session does not verify these screens or admin permissions.
- Source anchors use literal text and zero-based character offsets, not byte offsets.
- No credentials, tokens, or personal account data were copied into this report.

## Findings requiring care

- Daily reminders label a link click as Sent using daily browser-local storage. The label does not verify WhatsApp submission or delivery.
- Public shop tracking uses order number plus phone. The code defines input and display behavior; server authorization and information-disclosure limits remain untested.
- Signup has HTML minimum password length 6. Staff invitation activation requires 8 characters. Backend policy remains unknown.
- Platform tenant creation has old USD plan labels, while current public pricing uses INR and server plan definitions. Do not treat those labels as authoritative current prices.
- Several client service methods have no established UI control, including portal push unsubscribe, retention policy update, template toggle/delete, and some detail endpoints.
- Platform tenant deletion copy describes recoverable deletion for 30 days. Some older operation labels still say permanent deletion. Actual deletion scheduling was not exercised.
- Challenge reward days are returned by the API. Do not hard-code an observed account reward as a global rule.

## Module inventory

- Business authentication: 7 capabilities.
- Signup and onboarding: 9 capabilities.
- Staff activation: 1 capabilities.
- Pricing: 3 capabilities.
- Customer authentication: 8 capabilities.
- Customer portal: 17 capabilities.
- Public appointment booking: 6 capabilities.
- Public shop page: 8 capabilities.
- Fit Card: 6 capabilities.
- Customer connections: 6 capabilities.
- Shop progress: 4 capabilities.
- First orders challenge: 3 capabilities.
- Daily reminders: 3 capabilities.
- Explore and tailoring tools: 8 capabilities.
- Platform overview: 2 capabilities.
- Platform tenants: 13 capabilities.
- Platform subscriptions: 4 capabilities.
- Platform plans: 4 capabilities.
- Platform billing: 2 capabilities.
- Platform reporting: 2 capabilities.
- Platform audit: 1 capabilities.
- Platform announcements: 4 capabilities.
- Platform support: 2 capabilities.
- Platform WhatsApp inbox: 6 capabilities.
- Platform feature flags: 2 capabilities.
- Platform bulk operations: 3 capabilities.
- Platform system settings: 4 capabilities.
- Platform referral and promos: 2 capabilities.
- Platform administrator roles: 2 capabilities.
- Platform tenant health: 2 capabilities.
- Platform alerts: 3 capabilities.
- Platform data retention: 3 capabilities.
- Platform email templates: 3 capabilities.
- Platform trial management: 2 capabilities.
- Platform blog: 4 capabilities.

## Business authentication

- **Email and password sign-in.** POST /api/auth/login accepts email, password, and rememberMe. A pending_2fa response switches to code verification. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `async login(u) [character offset 194493]`.
- **Remember session option.** The login payload includes rememberMe; the visible option says remember me for 30 days. Server session duration is unverified. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `Remember me for 30 days [character offset 316925]`.
- **Google sign-in and role routing.** Business Google OAuth and callback lead to setup or a signed-in account. Platform administrator logins route to /platform/dashboard. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `l.role==="platform_admin" [character offset 320272]`.
- **Password reset link request.** POST /api/auth/forgot-password sends a normalized email; the confirmation avoids disclosing whether an account exists. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `/api/auth/forgot-password [character offset 309553]`.
- **Resend verification email.** POST /api/auth/resend-verification is offered after EMAIL_NOT_VERIFIED. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `/api/auth/resend-verification [character offset 309272]`.
- **Authenticator second factor.** Client defines setup/status, enable, disable, verify, and backup-code regeneration endpoints under /api/auth/2fa. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `async get2FAStatus() [character offset 195474]`.
- **Session refresh and sign-out.** Client refreshes access tokens and calls /api/auth/logout, then clears in-memory identity. This does not establish cookie attributes. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `async logout(){await z.post("/api/auth/logout") [character offset 194788]`.

## Signup and onboarding

- **Create a shop account.** Collect shopName, businessType, tailoring specialization, full name, email, phone, and password, then call register. Evidence: [SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js](evidence/assets/SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js) at `name:"shopName" [character offset 8120]`.
- **Tailor and boutique specialization.** Business setup distinguishes tailor, boutique, and both; tailoring specialization supports womens, mens, and unisex. Evidence: [SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js](evidence/assets/SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js) at `Women's Tailoring [character offset 8589]`.
- **Signup password visibility and minimum length.** Signup has a show/hide password button and HTML minLength 6. This differs from invited-staff activation requiring 8 characters. Evidence: [SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js](evidence/assets/SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js) at `minLength:6 [character offset 11831]`.
- **Email verification guidance.** Successful registration shows Check Your Email and a return-to-sign-in link. Evidence: [SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js](evidence/assets/SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js) at `Check Your Email [character offset 4176]`.
- **Referral and promotional code validation.** Preload ref or promo query values; validate uppercase codes at /api/referral/validate/:code or /api/referral/validate-promo/:code. Evidence: [SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js](evidence/assets/SignupPage-DcgW0U6K.js) at `/api/referral/validate-promo/ [character offset 1975]`.
- **Google account business setup.** Complete Google setup with setupToken, trimmed shopName, business type, specialization, phone, subscriptionPlan, and optional paymentInfo or discount code. Evidence: [SetupAccountPage-BN6SRHXV.js](evidence/assets/SetupAccountPage-BN6SRHXV.js) at `/api/auth/complete-google-setup [character offset 3158]`.
- **Plan selection and trial setup.** Google setup loads plan definitions and offers a free 90-day trial without a credit card. Evidence: [SetupAccountPage-BN6SRHXV.js](evidence/assets/SetupAccountPage-BN6SRHXV.js) at `All features for 90 days [character offset 2714]`.
- **Subscription checkout during setup.** Load Razorpay config, create a subscription payment order, launch checkout, and verify the payment before completing setup. Evidence: [SetupAccountPage-BN6SRHXV.js](evidence/assets/SetupAccountPage-BN6SRHXV.js) at `/api/subscriptions/verify-payment [character offset 4206]`.
- **Onboarding and tour persistence.** Client defines update/complete onboarding steps and update/complete/reset tour operations. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `async updateOnboardingStep(u) [character offset 195130]`.

## Staff activation

- **Accept an emailed staff invitation.** Read invite token, require matching password confirmation with at least 8 characters, call /api/users/accept-invitation, and redirect to login. Evidence: [AcceptInvitationPage-BRFf4EAo.js](evidence/assets/AcceptInvitationPage-BRFf4EAo.js) at `Password must be at least 8 characters [character offset 674]`.

## Pricing

- **Compare monthly and yearly plans.** Display plan prices, annualized monthly equivalent, yearly savings, customer/order/user limits, feature lists, and a popular badge. Prices are returned by the plan service. Evidence: [PricingPage-kSgQ6KPJ.js](evidence/assets/PricingPage-kSgQ6KPJ.js) at `See all features [character offset 5895]`.
- **Open detailed plan benefits.** Each plan opens a details modal containing its features and limits. Plan selection routes to /signup with plan and billing parameters. Evidence: [PricingPage-kSgQ6KPJ.js](evidence/assets/PricingPage-kSgQ6KPJ.js) at `/signup?plan= [character offset 11238]`.
- **Trial and pricing FAQs.** Public page advertises a 90-day free trial and answers plan switching, limits, security, and custom-plan questions. Marketing claims are not verified server guarantees. Evidence: [PricingPage-kSgQ6KPJ.js](evidence/assets/PricingPage-kSgQ6KPJ.js) at `Frequently asked questions [character offset 15255]`.

## Customer authentication

- **Shop-specific phone OTP login.** Request and verify OTP with phone and tenantId; optional customer name is accepted. Form validation expects 10 to 15 digits and a 6-digit OTP. Evidence: [PhoneOTPForm-CFStmPae.js](evidence/assets/PhoneOTPForm-CFStmPae.js) at `OTP must be 6 digits [character offset 875]`.
- **Shop-specific email OTP login.** Request and verify email OTP scoped to tenantId, with optional customer name. Offer resend OTP and change email. Evidence: [CustomerLoginPage-C-LCEe6F.js](evidence/assets/CustomerLoginPage-C-LCEe6F.js) at `requestEmailOTP [character offset 803]`.
- **Shop-specific Google login.** Start Google authentication through /api/customer-auth/google/:tenantId. Invalid or missing tenant links show an invalid-portal state. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `initiateGoogleLogin(l) [character offset 304493]`.
- **Global phone or email login.** Global portal accepts phone/email, requests OTP, verifies login, then opens the unified /customer/dashboard. Evidence: [GlobalCustomerLoginPage-B12AZ-h7.js](evidence/assets/GlobalCustomerLoginPage-B12AZ-h7.js) at `loginGlobal(T(),i,b) [character offset 7487]`.
- **Google identity completion.** Global Google authentication can request a phone number using pendingToken and optional tenantId. The phone capture validates 7 to 15 digits. Evidence: [GlobalCustomerLoginPage-B12AZ-h7.js](evidence/assets/GlobalCustomerLoginPage-B12AZ-h7.js) at `Enter a valid phone number (7–15 digits) [character offset 7051]`.
- **Linked shop selection.** Look up a customer across shops and offer shop selection when multiple links are returned. Client methods include lookupCustomer, selectShop, and verifyGlobalOTP. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `async selectShop(l,m,c) [character offset 303803]`.
- **OTP resend and back navigation.** Global flow has identifier, otp, phone_capture, and shops steps, separate error states, 6-digit input, and resend OTP. Evidence: [GlobalCustomerLoginPage-B12AZ-h7.js](evidence/assets/GlobalCustomerLoginPage-B12AZ-h7.js) at `Didn't receive it? Resend OTP [character offset 14695]`.
- **Customer session and profile identity.** Customer sessions have independent me, refresh, logout, and profile endpoints under /api/customer-auth. Evidence: [index-Dk-7hFgw.js](evidence/assets/index-Dk-7hFgw.js) at `async getCurrentCustomer() [character offset 305017]`.

## Customer portal

- **Unified and tenant-specific navigation.** Portal routes include dashboard, appointments, orders, measurements, invoices, and profile, under /customer or /:tenantId/customer. Evidence: [CustomerPortalLayout-BUJLLzxw.js](evidence/assets/CustomerPortalLayout-BUJLLzxw.js) at `path:"measurements" [character offset 1023]`.
- **Dashboard counts and recent activity.** Dashboard calculates total, in-progress, and completed orders, sorts orders by creation date, shows recent orders and upcoming appointments. Evidence: [CustomerDashboard-jtCnvllS.js](evidence/assets/CustomerDashboard-jtCnvllS.js) at `getMyAppointments(),G.getMyOrders() [character offset 2829]`.
- **Appointment booking shortcut.** Dashboard and portal navigation link to appointment booking for the selected shop. Evidence: [CustomerDashboard-jtCnvllS.js](evidence/assets/CustomerDashboard-jtCnvllS.js) at `Book Appointment [character offset 6073]`.
- **Read order list and production progress.** List items, statuses, amounts, and a production stage tracker. Delivered and completed orders are grouped as completed; cancelled is separate. Evidence: [CustomerOrders-COjUQ9C_.js](evidence/assets/CustomerOrders-COjUQ9C_.js) at `PRODUCTION STAGE [character offset 8056]`.
- **Search and filter orders across shops.** Search order number, garment, status, or shop; filter all/active/completed/cancelled and all shops or one linked shop. Evidence: [CustomerOrders-COjUQ9C_.js](evidence/assets/CustomerOrders-COjUQ9C_.js) at `Search by order ID, garment type or status [character offset 3638]`.
- **Read appointment history.** Appointments show upcoming, past, and cancelled sections with type, date, time, worker, and shop information. Evidence: [CustomerAppointments-DogJdX0V.js](evidence/assets/CustomerAppointments-DogJdX0V.js) at `No past appointments. [character offset 9303]`.
- **Search appointments across shops.** Filter appointment list by linked shop and search title, type, tailor/worker, shop, and status. Evidence: [CustomerAppointments-DogJdX0V.js](evidence/assets/CustomerAppointments-DogJdX0V.js) at `Search by type, tailor, or status [character offset 7378]`.
- **Cancel an appointment.** Confirmation calls POST /api/customer-portal/appointments/:id/cancel and reloads appointments. UI states the slot will be released. Evidence: [CustomerAppointments-DogJdX0V.js](evidence/assets/CustomerAppointments-DogJdX0V.js) at `This action cannot be undone. Your appointment slot will be released. [character offset 9882]`.
- **Read measurements by garment and shop.** Display saved measurement values, units, measured date, notes/label, garment category, and shop groups; expand and collapse groups. Evidence: [CustomerMeasurements-_8beXKQG.js](evidence/assets/CustomerMeasurements-_8beXKQG.js) at `getMyMeasurements() [character offset 1020]`.
- **Search and filter measurements.** Search garment, label, and notes; filter garment type and linked shop. Evidence: [CustomerMeasurements-_8beXKQG.js](evidence/assets/CustomerMeasurements-_8beXKQG.js) at `Search garment, label, notes [character offset 9177]`.
- **Read invoices and tax breakdown.** Invoice rows and details show invoice number, date, status, amount, subtotal, CGST, and SGST. Evidence: [CustomerInvoices-DmQNwrpG.js](evidence/assets/CustomerInvoices-DmQNwrpG.js) at `CGST ( [character offset 8192]`.
- **Search invoices across shops.** Search invoice number, shop, or status, and select one shop or all linked shops. Evidence: [CustomerInvoices-DmQNwrpG.js](evidence/assets/CustomerInvoices-DmQNwrpG.js) at `Search by invoice number, shop or status [character offset 3752]`.
- **Download customer invoice PDF.** Fetch /api/customer-portal/invoices/:id/download as a blob and trigger a local PDF download. Evidence: [customerPortal.service-giWeHoXZ.js](evidence/dependencies/customerPortal.service-giWeHoXZ.js) at `async downloadInvoicePdf(e) [character offset 683]`.
- **Share customer invoices.** Use Web Share API when available, with a WhatsApp fallback. Evidence: [CustomerInvoices-DmQNwrpG.js](evidence/assets/CustomerInvoices-DmQNwrpG.js) at `Share via WhatsApp [character offset 9789]`.
- **Update customer display name.** Profile rejects an empty name, trims the value, and updates only name; phone/email and linked shops are displayed. Evidence: [CustomerProfile-BZPOno0L.js](evidence/assets/CustomerProfile-BZPOno0L.js) at `await g({name:t.trim()}) [character offset 782]`.
- **Web push notification registration.** Register /sw.js, request notification permission, obtain VAPID public key, subscribe through PushManager, and send endpoint/key data to the portal API. Evidence: [CustomerPortalLayout-BUJLLzxw.js](evidence/assets/CustomerPortalLayout-BUJLLzxw.js) at `navigator.serviceWorker.register("/sw.js") [character offset 1499]`.
- **Push subscription service operations.** Client defines get VAPID key, subscribe, and unsubscribe endpoints. An unsubscribe UI action was not established. Evidence: [customerPortal.service-giWeHoXZ.js](evidence/dependencies/customerPortal.service-giWeHoXZ.js) at `async unsubscribePush(e) [character offset 992]`.

## Public appointment booking

- **Shop booking information.** GET /public/booking/:tenantId/info loads the shop name for a booking page. Evidence: [BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js](evidence/assets/BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js) at `/public/booking/${e}/info [character offset 15227]`.
- **Date and available slot selection.** Disable past dates, load available slots for a selected date, and convert start times into intervals using the requested 30-minute duration. Evidence: [BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js](evidence/assets/BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js) at `disablePast:!0 [character offset 18669]`.
- **Worker-aware availability service.** Available-slots request accepts date, duration, and optional workerId. The current page requests 30-minute slots without a worker selector. Evidence: [BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js](evidence/assets/BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js) at `h&&(f.workerId=h) [character offset 15341]`.
- **Sign in before confirmation.** Opening a slot asks unauthenticated users to use the phone OTP form, then returns to confirmation. Evidence: [BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js](evidence/assets/BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js) at `Sign in to Book [character offset 19835]`.
- **Book appointment type and notes.** Confirm fitting, delivery, consultation, or alteration with date/start/end/duration/title/notes and optional workerId. Then reload available slots. Evidence: [BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js](evidence/assets/BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js) at `type:O,appointmentDate:n.format [character offset 16822]`.
- **Booking success and empty states.** Show booking confirmation and email-confirmation copy, no-slots state, and shop/slot/booking error states. Email delivery was not tested. Evidence: [BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js](evidence/assets/BookingPage-DP4wDZcY.js) at `Booking Confirmed! [character offset 18272]`.

## Public shop page

- **Shop identity and contact presentation.** Show shop name, logo or initial, tagline or city, about, working hours, address, and completed order milestone. Evidence: [ShopPage-D_yutRey.js](evidence/assets/ShopPage-D_yutRey.js) at `a.completedOrders [character offset 4609]`.
- **Book visit and contact actions.** Link to bookingPath, WhatsApp with a prefilled greeting, telephone call, and Instagram when configured. Evidence: [ShopPage-D_yutRey.js](evidence/assets/ShopPage-D_yutRey.js) at `Book a visit [character offset 5262]`.
- **Showcase and lookbook.** Render featured work with photos, titles, from-prices, and product-specific WhatsApp enquiry text. Fall back to a lookbook when showcase is absent. Evidence: [ShopPage-D_yutRey.js](evidence/assets/ShopPage-D_yutRey.js) at `Our best work [character offset 7918]`.
- **Garment starting price list.** Display configured garment/service labels and from-prices, with a note that final price depends on fabric, design, and work. Evidence: [ShopPage-D_yutRey.js](evidence/assets/ShopPage-D_yutRey.js) at `Final price depends on fabric, design and work. [character offset 6307]`.
- **Track an order using phone and order number.** POST /api/public/shop/:slug/track with orderNumber and phone. Show item count, delivery date, current production step, and balance due. Evidence: [shopPage.service-BBjlG5I8.js](evidence/dependencies/shopPage.service-BBjlG5I8.js) at `async trackOrder(t,a,s) [character offset 302]`.
- **Order stage mapping.** Public tracker displays received, cutting, stitching, checking, ready, and delivered; cancelled disables the progress steps. Measuring falls back to order received. Evidence: [ShopPage-D_yutRey.js](evidence/assets/ShopPage-D_yutRey.js) at `case"quality_check":return{label:"Final checks",step:3} [character offset 3091]`.
- **Connect a customer in the mobile app.** Open nooltech://app/connect/:slug; explanatory copy says orders, payments, and measurements appear after shop approval. Link to Google Play is provided. Evidence: [ShopPage-D_yutRey.js](evidence/assets/ShopPage-D_yutRey.js) at `nooltech://app/connect/ [character offset 8495]`.
- **Unavailable shop handling.** When public shop lookup fails, show that the link may be wrong or the shop page may be off. Evidence: [ShopPage-D_yutRey.js](evidence/assets/ShopPage-D_yutRey.js) at `This shop page is not available [character offset 3837]`.

## Fit Card

- **Read a shared Fit Card.** Public token lookup shows customer name, expiration, garment/measurement labels, field values, unit, measuredAt, and shop/customer source attribution. Evidence: [FitCardPage-B6ZSmNUz.js](evidence/assets/FitCardPage-B6ZSmNUz.js) at `/api/public/fit-card/ [character offset 363]`.
- **Measurement provenance warning.** Shared Fit Card explicitly states measurements are customer-shared copies that must be checked before cutting. Evidence: [FitCardPage-B6ZSmNUz.js](evidence/assets/FitCardPage-B6ZSmNUz.js) at `These are copies the customer shared. [character offset 2668]`.
- **Open a Fit Card link or raw code.** Accept a /f/:token link or an alphanumeric/underscore/hyphen token of at least 20 characters; fetch it through authenticated /api/fit-card/:token. Evidence: [customerLinks.service-4RXT3vZR.js](evidence/dependencies/customerLinks.service-4RXT3vZR.js) at `[A-Za-z0-9_-]{20,} [character offset 69]`.
- **Choose measurement entries to import.** Fit Card import can send selected entryIds and associate imported measurements with an existing customer. Evidence: [customerLinks.service-4RXT3vZR.js](evidence/dependencies/customerLinks.service-4RXT3vZR.js) at `t.entryIds&&(r.entryIds=t.entryIds) [character offset 1045]`.
- **Create a customer from a Fit Card.** Import flow can add a customer or save measurements to an existing customer; copies become editable shop-owned measurements. Evidence: [FitCardImportDialog-BiI-ikQ8.js](evidence/assets/FitCardImportDialog-BiI-ikQ8.js) at `They are saved as your own measurements, which you can edit. [character offset 16026]`.
- **Confirm cross-phone imports.** Service accepts confirmOtherNumber, and dialog has Save anyway for phone mismatch handling. Duplicate/already-added status is displayed. # REA evidence and coverage

The requested [reverse-engineer-anything skill](/Users/nishanth/.agents/skills/reverse-engineer-anything/SKILL.md) was located through the skills registry and installed from [morluto/rea](https://github.com/morluto/rea). Its JavaScript artifact workflow was applied through the REA CLI, because no REA MCP tools were connected in this session. No MCP registration was changed.

## Inputs and method

The browser fetched 144 client JavaScript files from app.nooltech.com. They include the main entry bundle, lazy feature modules, and recursively identified non-vendor dependencies. Third-party vendor bundles were outside the selected artifact set. These files are shipped client artifacts, not the application's original source repository or server implementation.

The local text serialization appended one LF to each JavaScript response. [Asset provenance](evidence/asset-provenance.json) records both the browser-response SHA-256 and the local file SHA-256. Every difference was verified to be exactly that appended LF. REA Evidence identities address the retained local inputs.

REA parsed the selected files as inert JavaScript. It did not execute their bootstrap code. Ordinary browser navigation supplied separate UI observations. Static relationships and endpoint candidates do not establish runtime execution or server behavior.

## Analysis runs

| Run | Result | Parsed files | Evidence ID |
| --- | --- | ---: | --- |
| Main artifact directory | Partial Evidence retained after the main entry bundle reached its 300,000 ms per-source deadline | 112 | `ev_78ee01f9d41ed5574d08a8708e37c53f36eabff7c1eca5adab3c5c04cf863b3d` |
| Service/dependency directory | Completed analysis operation; graph limitations remain recorded | 22 | `ev_3aac0080063a3697e3a2768761befc0c4451b961a218816980acfeba2d2748db` |
| Remaining sources with lower semantic limits | The main bundle again reached the provider deadline; partial Evidence retained | 0 | `ev_23f23de5fec419d43d89651059a4bcdf22f91ec893a62f047f5deb5c2eb75514` |
| Nine remaining helper modules, with the main bundle excluded | Completed analysis operation | 9 | `ev_758d97fc328d93e3ad962cd1b6693861b8ac5dfde5c72bdfed811bc05bcc8b0f` |

REA therefore parsed **143 of the 144 captured files** across the retained runs. The main entry bundle was read directly to extract and validate route, service, translation, and authentication definitions. It was not successfully analysed to completion by REA.

The corrected runs followed REA's timeout remediation by selecting exact remaining sources and reducing retained semantic limits. The unchanged main-bundle operation was not repeatedly rerun. Semantic graph coverage remains partial because of dynamic expressions, unavailable imports, result limits, and the main-bundle timeout. Parsed-file coverage is distinct from complete semantic recovery.

The CLI package used was `rea-agents@6.8.0`. npm emitted an engine-range warning for the available Node `v26.4.0`. The outputs, timeout results, and coverage limitations are retained. No Node or native analysis engine upgrade was performed.

## Retained evidence

| Artifact | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| [REA summary](evidence/rea-summary.json) | Evidence IDs, source coverage, graph counts, limitations, and operation results |
| [Initial partial analysis](evidence/rea-analysis.json.gz) | Complete returned timeout envelope and its partial Evidence |
| [Dependency analysis](evidence/rea-dependencies.json.gz) | Complete returned dependency Evidence |
| [Reduced remaining-source attempt](evidence/rea-remaining.json.gz) | Complete returned timeout envelope and partial Evidence |
| [Helper analysis](evidence/rea-helpers.json.gz) | Complete returned helper Evidence |
| [Browser response digests](evidence/browser-asset-digests.json) | Original browser-read text byte lengths and digests |
| [Source provenance](evidence/asset-provenance.json) | Source URLs, local paths, digests, and serialization differences |

The compressed Evidence files preserve the returned JSON bytes. Compression was checked by comparing the uncompressed SHA-256 before removing duplicate uncompressed output. Decompress an Evidence file before supplying it to a CLI reader.

## Commands used

Package acquisition and analysis were run from the user's home directory, outside the inspected artifact directory. Absolute input and output paths were used. The first invocation was:

```bash
npx -y rea-agents@latest analyze-javascript-application \
	/Users/nishanth/projects/nishanth/fitloom/research_nooltech/evidence/assets \
	--json
```

Subsequent runs used the acquired installation's public `rea` launcher. The remaining-source selection used `--source-paths-json` with a recorded file list, `--max-semantic-nodes 5000`, `--max-semantic-nodes-per-file 500`, `--max-semantic-unknowns 5000`, and `--max-semantic-unknowns-per-file 500`. The final helper run selected the nine source files left after excluding the timed-out main bundle.

## Finding ledger

| Question | Evidence status |
| --- | --- |
| Which client pages and roles exist? | Answered for the retained router and module set. The [101-pattern route inventory](routes.csv) comes from direct source inspection. Reachability is separate. |
| Which capabilities does the shipped client define? | 412 entries have checked code anchors and explicit verification gaps. Related UI contexts are linked separately. |
| Which UI states were inspected? | The [browser observation index](browser_observations.csv) records the screens and forms. No business change was submitted. |
| What does REA establish? | Static evidence for the parsed artifact set, with recorded partial semantic coverage. The main entry bundle remains a REA analysis gap. |
| Are customer and platform administrator flows fully verified? | Partially answered. Customer sign-in/public pages were inspected; authenticated customer and platform administrator actions remain code-defined. |
| Are backend transactions, authorization, and messages verified? | Unresolved by this extraction. The client definitions and visible controls do not establish those properties. |

The [feature report](nooltech_feature_report.md) and [full catalog](feature_catalog.md) retain this evidence boundary.
